title: R. al-Inzāliyya ('On the Sending Down of Revelation')

date.basis: MK: 'completed before' the date of the Majlis 10196 copy (ff. 126b-28b); a copying date and only a terminus ad quem; not asterisked.

manuscript: 2 copies listed: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 126b-28b (17 Ramaḍān 828/2 Aug 1425); MS Majlis 10319/4 (13th/19th century).
summary: On the revelation of the heavenly Books treated in turn from exoteric, mystical and lettrist perspectives, rejecting two standard views of inzāl for the Sufis' applied metaphysical sense.
